post.summary: Create a return for an order
post.description:
Customer creates a return on their own delivered order.

Checks: ownership (uniform 404), delivered status, qty limits,
one active return per item, idempotency replay / mismatch.
reason_text is stored as plain data and never executed.

post.summary: Cancel a return request (customer, before approval)
post.description: Customer cancels own return; only while status is 'requested'.

Drive return state along the state-machine table.

Seller token: any allowed edge.
Agent-executor: only requested -> approved/rejected,
                within the autonomy cap from store_settings.

post.summary: Mark returned item received at warehouse (seller only)

Seller receives return at warehouse.
Transitions return from in_transit_back to received.

post.summary: Record inspection result for return (seller only)
post.description:
Seller records inspection result for received return.
Transitions return from received to inspected_ok / inspection_failed.
